zonas.title: Maya Knox — Zones
zonas.description: Sensors that trigger the alarm and the physical siren.

data_description.sensores_perimetro: Trigger whenever the alarm is armed.
data_description.sensores_internos: Only trigger in Away mode — ignored while Home.
data_description.entidade_sirene_alarme: Turned on when the alarm triggers.

campainha.title: Maya Knox — Doorbell
campainha.description: Who to notify when someone rings the doorbell.

data_description.sensor_campainha: Binary sensors only — the ring is detected by the 'on' state.
data_description.notify_servicos_campainha: notify.* services that receive the alert.
data_description.alexa_msg_campainha: Use {zona} for the name of the triggered sensor.
data_description.alexa_campainha_som_dispositivos: Echo that plays the sound in addition to the spoken announcement.

notificacoes.title: Maya Knox — Alarm notifications
notificacoes.description: Who to notify when the alarm triggers or changes state.

data_description.notify_servicos_sirene: Receives the trigger along with the camera image, when available.
data_description.alexa_msg_alarme: Use {msg} for the event text and {zona} for the sensor that triggered.

automacao.title: Maya Knox — Automation
automacao.description: Arm and disarm automatically from the residents' presence.

data.frigate_detect_ausente: Detections to enable in Away mode

data_description.moradores: Arms only when everyone is away.
data_description.rastreadores_omada: Added to the phones when computing presence.
data_description.frigate_detect_ausente: Enabled when arming Away and disabled when back Home.
data_description.sensores_pessoa_ausente: Trigger the alarm only in Away mode.
